question:
Study the given pie charts and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5ac36cb2f560a5b31ade9a205aaabaa22e04dba5d3032cd01ae5431e19e7234.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbf4b163e7149d4a79bbc8943a37597b266241b7e63ac8970e8977c761f1a8c4.png] 

If the ratio of the number of boys to that of the girls who passed from institute A is 5 ∶ 6, and 40% of the students who passed from institute D are boys, then the ratio of the number of boys who passed from institute A to that of boys who passed from institute D is:
solution:
**Calculation:**

Number of students passed in A = 1200 × 22/100

⇒ 264

Number of boys who passed from A = 264 × 5/11

⇒ 120

Number of students passed in D = 1200 × 20/100

⇒ 240

Number of boys who passed from D = 240 × 2/5

⇒ 96

Ratio = 120 : 96

⇒ 5 : 4

**∴ Required ratio is 5 : 4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**The number of boys who passed from A = (22/100) × (5/11) × 1200

The number of boys who passed from D = (20/100) × (2/5) × 1200

The required ratio = [(22/100) × (5/11) × 1200]/[(20/100) × (2/5) × 1200]

⇒ (2 × 5 × 12) ∶ (4 × 2 × 12)

⇒ 5 ∶ 4

∴ Required ratio is 5 : 4
